text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 28, 2019) for 1475 King Street West - Exterior

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 28, 2019, regarding the property located at 1475 King Street West - Exterior, Folder No. 19 239177 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to January 31, 2020.
